events.title: V0.8.9
events.summary: \・Reduced rendering load on the menu screen and enhanced graphics・Resolved an issue where the cutscene in Mission M.02 would stutter\・Added the ability to set vertical and horizontal camera speeds independently・Added the ability to adjust volume at any time via "Quick Settings" in the pause menu\Adjusted the difficulty, particularly in the early stages, to help newcomers get accustomed to the controls.・Adjusted the overall difficulty of Normal Mode・Reduced the fall speed threshold that triggers

events.title: v0.8.8
events.summary: ・Fixed an issue where the game would crash due to the GPU.・Mission S.02: Added a cutscene/event for falling off the bridge.・Mission M.02: Increased the visibility range so markers remain constantly visible.・Made minor text adjustments to reports.

events.title: v0.8.7
events.summary: ・Revised the GPU configuration method.We are currently investigating reports of crashes caused by the GPU.If you did not experience any issues with the previous version, there is no problem with skipping this version.

events.title: v0.8.6
events.summary: ・Adjusted the difficulty level for Normal Mode.・Unified the names "Synchro Charge" and "Synchro Guard" into "Synchro Barrier," and updated the content of related tutorials, reports, and other materials accordingly.About Synchro Barrier:There are no changes to the mechanics or in-game lore. The name and explanatory text have been revised to make its purpose and the optimal timing for its use clearer.

events.title: v0.8.5
events.summary: ・Added processing to filter out minor noise from stick inputs.・Added a feature to toggle movement controls between WASD and Arrow keys for keyboard and mouse input.・Changed the trigger threshold for the EN warning sound from 20% remaining to 30%.

events.title: Demo version Now Released
events.summary: I have released the trial version of CodePhantom.I hope you give it a try, and look forward to hearing your feedback and impressions on our message board or social media.Also released a new promotional video.
